This is a correction of an error in the independent oracle's own generation script, not a retune of a correct oracle to manufacture PASS: the defect was found by static code inspection first, then independently confirmed by three separately-formulated FEA element families (T3/T6/Q8, all agreeing with each other) and by re-running the orthogonal, already-existing, machine-precision-verified scripts/lafea-bucket-01-pure-shear-check.mjs sign-convention patch test. Full rationale in this file's v2OracleCorrection block. frozenBeforeAnyB02bV2ProductionObservation is honestly false: unlike B02D-V2's mesh-quality trials, this correction was necessarily informed by observing that FEA response disagreed with the v1 oracle -- see v2OracleCorrection.detectionMethod and .independentConfirmation for exactly what that means and does not mean.
